title: Atlas DataFlow Dataset Semantic Intent v2
description: Project Spec S0206. Governed, dataset-specific authored meaning for one dataset, reviewed by a human authoring the dataset's Atlas integration -- v2 of pipeline/dataset-semantic-intent.schema.json, additive and non-mutating of the v1 contract. Preserves the same architecture-level authored-meaning ownership boundary as v1 (field role decisions, missing-value/categorical intent, human-reviewed public meaning) but replaces v1's binary-only target_semantics with a governed, ordered multiclass target semantics shape that never defines a positive/negative class, an encoded positive label, a probability, a threshold, or a risk band. Must never own observed source measurements, scientific EDA conclusions, or training outcomes, the same as v1.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this dataset semantic-intent document.

artifact_type.description: Explicit artifact type identifying this document as governed dataset semantic intent.

dataset_identity.description: Dataset-specific identity this semantic intent governs. Every semantic decision in this document is scoped to exactly this dataset.

dataset_slug.description: Stable dataset slug this semantic intent belongs to.

authoring_generation_id.description: Identifier of the immutable authoring generation this semantic intent belongs to. Must agree with the referencing dataset-integration authoring manifest's authoring_generation.authoring_generation_id.

governing_capability_profile.description: Typed identity/version of the capability profile that determines whether target_semantics is required, optional, or forbidden for this document. Must agree with the referencing authoring manifest's selected capability profile.

field_role_decisions.description: Authored, reviewed role decision for each field this semantic intent covers. Observed facts (types, null rates, cardinality) must come from discovery evidence, not from this array.

role.description: Authored semantic role for this field. 'identifier' fields are never features. 'target' is only valid when governing_capability_profile permits target semantics.

include_in_features.description: Explicit feature inclusion/exclusion intent for this field. Must be false when role is 'identifier', 'target', or 'ignored'.

exclusion_reason.description: Required rationale when include_in_features is false and role is not 'identifier'.

missing_value_intent.description: Authored missing-value semantic intent for this field, distinct from discovery evidence's observed null counts.

policy.description: Authored policy for how missing values in this field are semantically intended to be treated.

fixed_value.description: Typed fixed value used only when policy is 'impute_fixed_value'.

categorical_domain_intent.description: Authored categorical/domain intent for this field, present only when the field has a reviewed closed or open domain.

closed_for_inference.description: True when accepted_values is authored as a provably complete, closed domain rather than an open/inferred sample.

source_basis.description: Traceable rationale for how this domain was reviewed, e.g. a reference to the discovery evidence field observation it was reviewed against.

target_semantics.description: Authored governed multiclass target/result semantics. Must be entirely omitted -- not present as a null or empty placeholder -- when governing_capability_profile forbids target semantics. Never defines a positive/negative class, an encoded positive label, a probability, a threshold, or a risk band -- those remain exclusively binary-classification concepts owned by v1.

task_type.description: Only 'multiclass_classification' is a governed task type under this schema version. A new task_type value requires a new schema version, never an ad hoc string.

classes.description: The complete, normatively ordered set of governed classes for this target. Array order is normative and must never be sorted, reordered, or re-derived (e.g. alphabetically, or from discovery evidence, target distribution, model output, or UI) by any validator or consumer.

class_id.description: Stable, authored identifier for this governed class.

display_label.description: Human-readable display label for this governed class.

is_final_training_configuration.description: Must always be false. Target semantics authored here are not final training configuration without later validation and stage authorization.

authored_public_meaning.description: Optional human-reviewed safe public-meaning or projection intent for this dataset, distinct from any generated public contract.

authoring_rationale_refs.description: Optional traceability references to authoring rationale or governed scientific-evidence artifacts this semantic intent was reviewed against. Must not embed raw scientific-evidence payloads.

semantic_boundary_confirmations.description: Explicit confirmation that this semantic-intent document does not own observed facts, scientific conclusions, training outcomes, release state, or model bytes. All flags are required and fixed.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this semantic-intent document was generated.
